Markets.title: Global Market Today: Asian stocks slide as AI fears trigger selloff
Markets.summary: Asian stocks fell 1%, extending losses to a seventh consecutive session amid fears surrounding artificial intelligence. This decline pushed the MSCI All Country World Index toward its longest losing streak since September 2023.

Markets.title: Anthropic shares surge 34% in Nasdaq debut, valuation hits $2 trillion
Markets.summary: AI startup Anthropic raised $81.3 billion in its Nasdaq debut after pricing shares at $111.50, up from its $83 target. The successful stock offering pushed the company's market valuation to $2 trillion.

Markets.title: AMD shares slide 8% as report says China links could invite US scrutiny
Markets.summary: AMD shares dropped 8% following a report that its technology and licensing revenue are linked to blacklisted Chinese firms. This connection to a Chinese server manufacturer and restricted entities could trigger increased regulatory scrutiny from the U.S. government.

Markets.title: Amundi CIO says not bearish on France bonds, AI at the start of repricing
Markets.summary: Amundi Chief Investment Officer Vincent Mortier stated he is not bearish on French government bonds despite current fiscal concerns and rising yields. He favors bonds from countries with lower debt-to-GDP ratios and shorter maturities while noting potential future interest in Japanese government debt.

Markets.title: Sebi roadmap focuses on faster IPOs, easier foreign investor access: Official
Markets.summary: Sebi is streamlining IPO and rights issue timelines to improve market efficiency and economic expansion. The regulator is also enhancing corporate bond markets and reforming municipal bond issuances for infrastructure financing.

Geo-Political.title: Anthropic becomes one of world's most valuable public companies in stock market debut
Geo-Political.summary: Anthropic has become a publicly traded company through its stock market debut. This makes it the first purely artificial intelligence company to be publicly listed.

Geo-Political.title: 'I tell my son it's just fireworks': People inside besieged Yemeni city speak to BBC
Geo-Political.summary: Orla Guerin speaks with seven residents trapped inside the Yemeni city of Taiz by Houthi forces. The interviewees reveal the harsh daily realities of living under the ongoing siege.

Geo-Political.title: Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya minority, top UN court rules
Geo-Political.summary: The International Court of Justice ruled that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya minority during a 2017 military crackdown. The unprecedented verdict relates to military operations that resulted in the deaths of thousands of people.

Geo-Political.title: Europe ready for talks with Russia on ending war in Ukraine, leaders say
Geo-Political.summary: European leaders meeting in Berlin stated they share a united negotiating position. They announced Europe is ready to hold talks with Russia to end the war in Ukraine.

Geo-Political.title: Trump, Putin and Xi release 'peace declaration' after historic meeting
Geo-Political.summary: U.S. President Trump, Russian President Putin, and Chinese President Xi held their first-ever trilateral meeting. Following the discussion, the three leaders released a joint peace declaration.

Geo-Political.title: California targets Nvidia in China AI chip probe
Geo-Political.summary: California is investigating Nvidia, its local AI chipmaker, regarding its artificial intelligence chips sent to China. This regulatory probe began shortly after former CEO Jensen Huang stepped down from the company.

Data & Insights.title: Govt weighing ways to boost long-term credit to manufacturing: DEA secretary Anuradha Thakur
Data & Insights.summary: The Department of Economic Affairs Secretary, Anuradha Thakur, stated that the government is exploring methods to increase long-term credit for the manufacturing sector. She also urged large corporations to engage in public-private partnerships, collaborate with smaller enterprises, and tackle wage stagnation.

Data & Insights.title: More economic red signals in October—but not everywhere, shows Mint tracker
Data & Insights.summary: The Mint economic tracker shows warning signals flashing across India in October, though producer and industrial segments remain resilient. The second half of the year is expected to be more difficult as the positive effects of previous GST rate cuts and interest rate changes diminish.

Data & Insights.title: UK inflation hits one-year high of 3.6%: Why are markets less convinced of another rate hike? | Explained
Data & Insights.summary: UK inflation rose to a one-year high of 3.6% in October due to increased fuel prices and tobacco taxes. Despite this increase, steady core and services inflation reduced market expectations for a December Bank of England rate hike.

Data & Insights.title: Trump, Xi, Putin unite $1.48 Trillion military might at Shenzhen: Will nukes be on the table? Why it matters
Data & Insights.summary: US President Donald Trump has arrived in Shenzhen, China, for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit. On Thursday, he is scheduled to hold a high-stakes meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin.

Data & Insights.title: Soybean oil's share rises in India's edible oil import mix
Data & Insights.summary: India imported 5.83 million tonnes of soybean oil during the 2025-26 period. This accounted for a portion of the country's total edible oil imports of 16.92 million tonnes.

Data & Insights.title: Could AI boom trigger a jobs crisis? The risks Fed Chair Kevin Warsh sees beyond productivity gains
Data & Insights.summary: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh warns that the AI boom could cause widespread job displacement through automation. Alternatively, he notes it may drive faster economic growth or trigger an economic slowdown if market expectations fail.

India.title: Cyclone Akvan LIVE Updates: Akvan Weakens Into Cyclonic Storm, Likely To Cross Odisha-Andhra Coast Today
India.summary: Cyclone Akvan has weakened into a cyclonic storm over the west-central Bay of Bengal. It is expected to cross the Odisha-Andhra coast today.

India.title: Resignation Not Admission Of Guilt: Justice Yashwant Varma Tells Lok Sabha Secretariat
India.summary: Justice Yashwant Varma sent a September 10 letter to Lok Sabha Secretary General Utpal Kumar Singh regarding an inquiry committee report. He stated that his resignation should not be interpreted as an admission of guilt.

India.title: 47 Train Cancelled, Over 3 Lakh Evacuated As Cyclone Akvan Heads To Odisha
India.summary: Odisha evacuated over 300,000 people and cancelled 47 trains as it prepares for the impending arrival of Cyclone Akvan. Chief Minister Mohan Charan Majhi reviewed the state's preparedness and response measures to handle the storm.

India.title: Uttarakhand Bank Manager, 2 Agents Arrested In Rs 9 Lakh Bribery Case
India.summary: An Uttarakhand bank manager and two agents were arrested for demanding a 5 percent bribe to process a Rs 1.8 crore loan. The accused allegedly sought Rs 9 lakh from the complainant to facilitate the loan's sanction and disbursement.

India.title: Azam Khan's 'Biryani' Jibe At Asaduddin Owaisi Amid Tussle For UP Muslim Votes
India.summary: AIMIM chief Asaduddin Owaisi has allied with the Azad Samaj Party to contest the upcoming Uttar Pradesh assembly elections. Azam Khan criticized this political move amid competition for Muslim votes in the state.

India.title: How's He Called 'Youth Leader' At 56? Rahul Gandhi Shares His Formula: "Ridiculous Questions"
India.summary: At a Chicago event, 56-year-old Indian politician Rahul Gandhi responded to those questioning why he is still called a youth leader. He brushed off the criticism and shared his own personal definition of youth.

General.title: Woman drugged and advertised for sex by husband speaks out as abusers found guilty
General.summary: Joanne Young spoke out after a court found her husband and another man guilty of drugging her and advertising her for sex over a 13-year period. Young stated that the abuse completely destroyed her previous life.

General.title: Tens of thousands of UK fridges secured from hackers in secret nationwide operation
General.summary: A secret nationwide operation in the UK secured tens of thousands of commercial fridges from hackers. Facilities including supermarkets, warehouses, restaurants, and stadiums rushed to make their connected devices safe.
